name: coredns_servfail_error_rate_critical
title: CoreDNS SERVFAIL Error Rate Critical
description: CoreDNS is returning SERVFAIL of DNS responses, meaning a large share of client queries are failing to resolve.

source.upstream_query: sum without (pod, instance, server, zone, view, rcode, plugin) (rate(coredns_dns_responses_total{rcode="SERVFAIL"}[5m])) / sum without (pod, instance, server, zone, view, rcode, plugin) (rate(coredns_dns_responses_total[5m])) > 0.03
source.upstream_description: CoreDNS is returning SERVFAIL for {{ $value | humanizePercentage }} of DNS responses, meaning a large share of client queries are failing to resolve.

query_condition.promql: sum without (pod, instance, server, zone, view, rcode, plugin) (rate(coredns_dns_responses_total{rcode="SERVFAIL"}[5m])) / sum without (pod, instance, server, zone, view, rcode, plugin) (rate(coredns_dns_responses_total[5m]))
